_schema: Continuous validation baselines (MASTER_STRATEGIC_PLAN.md Part 11). Each entry stores the reference AUC-PR for a monthly IEDB benchmark; the workflow alerts on a >3% relative drop. A null auc_pr means the baseline has not yet been established and will be seeded on the first successful run.

iedb_ebv_hpv16_tcell.note: EBV + HPV16 IEDB T-cell export scored with the pinned feature_mode=31 production model. Seeded automatically on the first monthly run; subsequent runs compare against the stored value.
